name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit_note: Paid directly to your bank in 3 instalments of ₹2,000
summary: Income support for landholding farmer families, paid straight into their Aadhaar-seeded bank account three times a year.
description: PM-KISAN gives every eligible landholding farmer family ₹6,000 a year to help with farm inputs and household needs. The money is sent in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 (April–July, August–November, December–March) directly to the farmer's bank account.
eligibility_summary: Farmer families who own cultivable land recorded in their name.

eligibility_points.title: Landholding farmer family
eligibility_points.detail: Husband, wife and minor children who own cultivable land as per state land records.

eligibility_points.title: Aadhaar-linked bank account
eligibility_points.detail: An active bank account seeded with Aadhaar for direct transfer.

eligibility_points.title: Land records verified
eligibility_points.detail: Land must be recorded in the applicant's name in state revenue records.

eligibility_points.title: e-KYC completed
eligibility_points.detail: OTP, biometric or face-based e-KYC is mandatory to receive instalments.

exclusions: Current or former holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, MLAs
Serving or retired government employees (except Group D / MTS)
Pensioners getting ₹10,000 or more per month
People who paid income tax in the last assessment year
Registered professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers and CAs

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.detail: Linked to a working mobile number for OTP.

documents.name: Land records (Khatauni / RoR)
documents.detail: Latest record from the state revenue department.

documents.name: Bank passbook
documents.detail: Showing account holder name, account number and IFSC.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: Self-register on pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner) or visit your nearest CSC.

steps.title: Land verification
steps.detail: The state patwari / revenue officer verifies your land records.

steps.title: Complete e-KYC
steps.detail: Finish OTP or biometric e-KYC on the portal or at a CSC.

steps.title: Receive instalments
steps.detail: ₹2,000 is credited to your Aadhaar-linked account every four months.

faqs.q: Can both husband and wife get PM-KISAN?
faqs.a: No. The benefit is per farmer family (husband, wife and minor children), so only one member can receive it.

faqs.q: How do I check my payment status?
faqs.a: Use 'Know Your Status' on pmkisan.gov.in with your registration number or Aadhaar.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
benefit_note: Per family per year at 30,000+ empanelled hospitals
summary: Free, cashless treatment for serious illnesses at government and private empanelled hospitals across India.
description: PM-JAY covers hospital stays, surgeries and treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family every year, with no cap on family size or age. It covers 3 days before and 15 days after hospitalisation, including medicines and diagnostics. Eligible families get an Ayushman Card.
eligibility_summary: Poor and vulnerable families identified in the SECC 2011 database or holding priority ration cards as notified by your state.

eligibility_points.title: SECC 2011 listed family
eligibility_points.detail: Rural families with deprivation criteria and urban families in listed occupations.

eligibility_points.title: State-notified ration card holders
eligibility_points.detail: Many states extend PM-JAY to all NFSA / priority ration card families.

eligibility_points.title: Seniors aged 70+
eligibility_points.detail: All citizens 70 and above are covered separately under Ayushman Vay Vandana.

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.detail: For e-KYC of each family member.

documents.name: Ration card
documents.detail: Or the PM letter / family ID used to identify eligible families.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.detail: Search your name at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or call 14555.

steps.title: Make your Ayushman Card
steps.detail: Complete e-KYC on the Ayushman app, at a CSC or an empanelled hospital.

steps.title: Get treated
steps.detail: Show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk in any empanelled hospital.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay anything at the hospital?
faqs.a: No. Treatment covered under the package is cashless and paperless for eligible families.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (PM-JAY for Seniors 70+)
benefit_note: Every citizen aged 70+, regardless of income
summary: Free hospital cover of ₹5 lakh a year for every senior citizen aged 70 and above, whatever their income.
description: Since October 2024, all citizens aged 70 years and above can get the Ayushman Vay Vandana card. Families already under PM-JAY get an extra top-up of ₹5 lakh shared among members aged 70+.
eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen aged 70 years or more, based on Aadhaar age.

eligibility_points.title: Aged 70 or above
eligibility_points.detail: Age as recorded in Aadhaar.

eligibility_points.title: No income test
eligibility_points.detail: Open to all economic groups.

exclusions: Seniors who choose to stay in CGHS, ECHS or CAPF schemes must pick one scheme

steps.title: Enrol
steps.detail: Use the Ayushman app or beneficiary.nha.gov.in and select 'Vay Vandana'.

steps.title: Complete e-KYC
steps.detail: Aadhaar OTP or face authentication.

steps.title: Download card
steps.detail: Use it at any empanelled hospital.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
benefit_note: Deposit-free connection, first refill and stove; ₹300 subsidy on up to 12 refills a year
summary: Deposit-free LPG gas connection for women from poor households, with a targeted subsidy on refills.
description: Ujjwala 2.0 gives an adult woman from a poor household a free LPG connection, first refill and hot plate. Beneficiaries also get a targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills a year.
eligibility_summary: Adult women from poor households that do not already have an LPG connection.

eligibility_points.title: Adult woman applicant
eligibility_points.detail: 18 years or older.

eligibility_points.title: Poor household
eligibility_points.detail: SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY, forest dweller, tea garden, or other deprived household (14-point declaration).

eligibility_points.title: No LPG at home
eligibility_points.detail: No one in the household should already have an LPG connection.

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.detail: Of the applicant and adult family members.

documents.name: Ration card
documents.detail: Or a self-declaration for migrant families.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: Apply on pmuy.gov.in or at the nearest LPG distributor.

steps.title: KYC
steps.detail: Distributor completes KYC and verification.

steps.title: Get connection
steps.detail: Receive cylinder, regulator and stove free of cost.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
benefit_note: ₹1.30 lakh in hilly / NE / difficult areas, plus 90–95 days MGNREGA wages
summary: Money to build a pucca house for rural families who are homeless or living in kutcha or damaged houses.
description: PMAY-G helps rural families build a pucca house with basic amenities. Assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plains) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly states and difficult areas) is paid in instalments to the beneficiary's bank account as construction progresses, with extra support for a toilet under Swachh Bharat Mission.
eligibility_summary: Rural households that are homeless or live in kutcha / dilapidated houses, selected from Awaas+ survey lists.

eligibility_points.title: Houseless or kutcha house
eligibility_points.detail: Families living in zero, one or two-room kutcha houses.

eligibility_points.title: Listed in Awaas+ survey
eligibility_points.detail: Selection is verified by the Gram Sabha.

exclusions: Families with a government employee or income taxpayer
Owners of motorised vehicles, mechanised farm equipment or KCC limit of ₹50,000+

steps.title: Get listed
steps.detail: Contact your Gram Panchayat to check the Awaas+ list.

steps.title: Sanction
steps.detail: Block office sanctions the house after Gram Sabha approval.

steps.title: Build and get paid
steps.detail: Instalments are released after geo-tagged photos of each stage.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
benefit_note: For building, buying or renting a house; interest subsidy on home loans
summary: Help for urban poor and middle-income families without a pucca house to build, buy or rent a home.
description: PMAY-U 2.0 supports urban EWS, LIG and MIG families through beneficiary-led construction, affordable housing, affordable rental housing and an interest subsidy scheme on home loans.
eligibility_summary: Urban families with annual income up to ₹9 lakh who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

eligibility_points.title: No pucca house
eligibility_points.detail: No family member should own a pucca house anywhere in India.

eligibility_points.title: Income band
eligibility_points.detail: EWS up to ₹3 lakh, LIG ₹3–6 lakh, MIG ₹6–9 lakh a year.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.detail: Fill the application on pmay-urban.gov.in.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: Your urban local body verifies your details.

steps.title: Receive support
steps.detail: Assistance is released in stages or as a loan subsidy.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
benefit_note: Per rural household per year, at the state-notified wage rate
summary: A legal guarantee of up to 100 days of paid manual work each year for every rural household that asks for it.
description: Any adult in a rural household can ask for unskilled work under MGNREGA. Work must be given within 15 days of asking, within 5 km of home where possible, and wages are paid directly to the bank account within 15 days.
eligibility_summary: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.

eligibility_points.title: Rural resident
eligibility_points.detail: Living in a rural area covered by a Gram Panchayat.

eligibility_points.title: Job card
eligibility_points.detail: Household must register for a free job card.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: Apply for a job card at your Gram Panchayat.

steps.title: Ask for work
steps.detail: Submit a written or oral request for work and take a dated receipt.

steps.title: Work and get paid
steps.detail: Wages are credited within 15 days.

faqs.q: What if I don't get work in 15 days?
faqs.a: You are entitled to an unemployment allowance from the state.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit_note: From age 60, with pension continuing to spouse and corpus to nominee
summary: A government-guaranteed pension from age 60 for workers who save a small amount every month.
description: Join between 18 and 40 and contribute monthly through your savings account. At 60 you receive a fixed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month, depending on your contribution. After you, your spouse gets the same pension and the nominee receives the savings.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens aged 18–40 with a bank account who are not income taxpayers.

eligibility_points.title: Age 18 to 40
eligibility_points.detail: Contributions continue until age 60.

eligibility_points.title: Savings bank account
eligibility_points.detail: With auto-debit enabled.

exclusions: People who are or have been income taxpayers (from 1 Oct 2022)

steps.title: Visit your bank
steps.detail: Or use net banking / mobile app.

steps.title: Choose pension amount
steps.detail: Pick ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 and nominee.

steps.title: Auto-debit
steps.detail: Monthly contribution is debited automatically.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit_note: For just ₹436 a year, auto-debited
summary: Low-cost life insurance of ₹2 lakh for anyone aged 18–50 with a bank account.
description: PMJJBY is a one-year renewable life cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason. The premium of ₹436 a year is auto-debited from your bank account.
eligibility_summary: Anyone aged 18–50 with a savings bank or post office account.

steps.title: Enrol
steps.detail: At your bank branch, net banking or jansuraksha.gov.in.

steps.title: Auto-renew
steps.detail: Premium is debited every year in May–June.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit_note: For ₹20 a year; ₹1 lakh for partial disability
summary: Accident insurance of ₹2 lakh for just ₹20 a year.
description: PMSBY pays ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. The ₹20 yearly premium is auto-debited.
eligibility_summary: Anyone aged 18–70 with a savings bank or post office account.

steps.title: Enrol
steps.detail: At your bank, post office or jansuraksha.gov.in.

steps.title: Renew yearly
steps.detail: Premium auto-debited each year.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit_note: Tax-free; rate set by government every quarter
summary: A tax-free savings account for your daughter's education and marriage, with one of the highest small-savings interest rates.
description: Parents can open an account for a girl child below 10 years with as little as ₹250 a year (maximum ₹1.5 lakh). Deposits are made for 15 years and the account matures after 21 years. Deposits get tax deduction under section 80C and interest is tax-free.
eligibility_summary: Parents or guardians of a girl child below 10 years (up to two daughters).

steps.title: Open account
steps.detail: At any post office or authorised bank.

steps.title: Deposit yearly
steps.detail: Minimum ₹250, maximum ₹1.5 lakh per year for 15 years.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
local_name: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
benefit_note: Subsidy for 3 kW rooftop solar, up to 300 free units a month
summary: A subsidy to put solar panels on your roof and cut your electricity bill to nearly zero.
description: Households get ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the third kW, up to ₹78,000. The subsidy is credited to your bank account after the system is installed and inspected. Collateral-free loans are also available.
eligibility_summary: Households that own a house with a suitable roof and a valid electricity connection.

eligibility_points.title: Own house with roof
eligibility_points.detail: Roof suitable for solar panels.

eligibility_points.title: Valid electricity connection
eligibility_points.detail: In the applicant's name.

eligibility_points.title: No previous solar subsidy
eligibility_points.detail: Not availed any other rooftop solar subsidy.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: On pmsuryaghar.gov.in with your consumer number.

steps.title: Choose vendor
steps.detail: Pick a registered vendor and install.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.detail: DISCOM inspects and installs net meter.

steps.title: Get subsidy
steps.detail: Credited within about 30 days.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
benefit_note: Plus yearly academic allowance of ₹2,500–₹13,500
summary: Full reimbursement of compulsory fees plus an allowance for SC students from Class 11 to PhD.
description: SC students studying after Class 10 get their compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed and an academic allowance depending on the course. Payment is made directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded account.
eligibility_summary: SC students in Class 11 or higher with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year.

steps.title: Register on NSP
steps.detail: Create a One Time Registration on scholarships.gov.in or your state portal.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: Fill the form and upload documents.

steps.title: Institute verification
steps.detail: Your college verifies the application.

deadline_note: Usually opens July–October each academic year

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT Students
benefit_note: Rates vary by course and state
summary: Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students studying after Class 10.
description: Covers non-refundable fees and a maintenance allowance for OBC, economically backward and de-notified tribe students in post-matric courses.
eligibility_summary: OBC / EBC / DNT students in Class 11 or higher with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.detail: Through your state scholarship portal or NSP.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: Institute and district verify.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
benefit_note: Collateral-free in three tranches, 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback
summary: Collateral-free loans for street vendors to restart and grow their business.
description: Street vendors can take a first working capital loan and, on repaying it on time, become eligible for bigger loans. Timely repayment earns a 7% interest subsidy and digital payments earn cashback.
eligibility_summary: Street vendors vending in urban areas with a vending certificate or recommendation letter.

documents.name: Vending certificate / ID
documents.detail: Or letter of recommendation from ULB.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: On pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or at a CSC.

steps.title: Loan sanction
steps.detail: Lender sanctions and disburses.

steps.title: Repay digitally
steps.detail: Use UPI to earn cashback and the next loan.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
benefit_note: Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories — no collateral
summary: Collateral-free loans for small non-farm businesses like shops, workshops and service units.
description: Mudra loans are offered by banks, NBFCs and MFIs: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000–₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5–10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (₹10–20 lakh for those who repaid a Tarun loan).
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens with a non-farm income-generating business plan in manufacturing, trading or services.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At any bank branch or on jansamarth.in.

steps.title: Appraisal
steps.detail: Bank reviews your plan.

steps.title: Disbursal
steps.detail: Loan amount credited / MUDRA card issued.

name: Stand-Up India
benefit_note: For a new (greenfield) business
summary: Bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs starting a new business.
description: Each bank branch supports at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower with a composite loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for a new enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or allied agriculture.
eligibility_summary: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs aged 18+ setting up a new enterprise.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: On standupmitra.in.

steps.title: Connect with bank
steps.detail: Portal links you to lenders and support agencies.

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative (DAY-NRLM)
benefit_note: Skill training, interest subvention and enterprise support for SHG women
summary: Helps women in self-help groups build livelihoods that earn at least ₹1 lakh a year.
description: Under DAY-NRLM, SHG members get livelihood planning, skill training (including drone operation, LED making, plumbing), access to bank credit with interest subvention, and market linkages.
eligibility_summary: Women members of self-help groups under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission.

steps.title: Join an SHG
steps.detail: Contact your block mission office or CRP.

steps.title: Livelihood plan
steps.detail: Prepare an enterprise plan with your VO.

steps.title: Training and credit
steps.detail: Get skills and bank linkage.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
benefit_note: Central share; most states add more
summary: A monthly pension for elderly people from below-poverty-line households.
description: Under the National Social Assistance Programme, BPL senior citizens get ₹200 a month (age 60–79) or ₹500 a month (age 80+) from the Centre. States add their own top-up, so the actual amount is usually higher.
eligibility_summary: Persons aged 60 or above belonging to BPL households.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At the Gram Panchayat / municipal office or state pension portal.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: Block or district social welfare office verifies.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
benefit_note: Central share; states add more
summary: Monthly pension for widows from BPL households.
description: Widows aged 40–79 from BPL households get ₹300 a month from the Centre, with additional state top-ups. At 80 they move to the old age pension of ₹500.
eligibility_summary: Widows aged 40–79 belonging to BPL households.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At your block / municipal office or state portal.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: Social welfare officer verifies.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
benefit_note: Central share; states add more
summary: Monthly pension for persons with severe disabilities from BPL households.
description: Persons aged 18–79 with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more) from BPL households get ₹300 a month from the Centre plus state top-up.
eligibility_summary: Persons aged 18–79 with 80%+ disability from BPL households.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At your block / municipal office.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: District social welfare office verifies.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit_note: Farmer pays 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (commercial crops)
summary: Low-premium insurance that pays farmers when crops are lost to drought, flood, pests or disease.
description: PMFBY covers yield losses, prevented sowing and post-harvest losses from natural calamities. The government pays the rest of the actuarial premium.
eligibility_summary: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers.

steps.title: Enrol
steps.detail: Through your bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date.

steps.title: Report loss
steps.detail: Report localised loss within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance app or 14447.

deadline_note: Kharif: usually by 31 July · Rabi: usually by 31 December

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit_note: 7% interest with 3% prompt-repayment incentive, limit up to ₹5 lakh
summary: Easy, cheap credit for seeds, fertiliser, livestock and fisheries.
description: KCC gives farmers, fishers and animal-husbandry farmers a revolving credit limit. Under the interest subvention scheme the effective rate is 4% for timely repayment. Loans up to ₹2 lakh need no collateral.
eligibility_summary: Farmers (owners, tenants, sharecroppers), fishers and animal-husbandry farmers.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At any bank branch or through PM-KISAN portal's KCC form.

steps.title: Card issued
steps.detail: Usually within 14 days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
benefit_note: ₹5,000 for the first child; ₹6,000 if the second child is a girl
summary: Cash support for pregnant women and new mothers to rest and eat well.
description: PMMVY pays ₹5,000 for the first child in two instalments after pregnancy registration, ante-natal check-ups, birth registration and vaccination. For a second child who is a girl, ₹6,000 is paid after birth.
eligibility_summary: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19+, except those in regular government jobs.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: At your Anganwadi / health centre or pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

steps.title: Get instalments
steps.detail: Paid after each condition is met.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (NFSA free ration)
benefit_note: Antyodaya families get 35 kg per family per month
summary: Free rice or wheat every month for ration card holders under the Food Security Act.
description: Priority households get 5 kg of free food grains per person per month and Antyodaya Anna Yojana families get 35 kg per family, through fair price shops. One Nation One Ration Card lets you collect anywhere in India.
eligibility_summary: Families holding Priority Household (PHH) or Antyodaya (AAY) ration cards.

documents.name: Aadhaar
documents.detail: For biometric authentication at the shop.

steps.title: Get a ration card
steps.detail: Apply through your state food department.

steps.title: Collect grains
steps.detail: At any fair price shop with biometric check.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit_note: Plus ₹15,000 toolkit voucher and ₹500/day training stipend
summary: Recognition, training, toolkits and cheap loans for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
description: Artisans in 18 trades — carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, tailors, cobblers, barbers and more — get a PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID, skill training with stipend, a toolkit e-voucher and collateral-free loans of ₹1 lakh and ₹2 lakh at 5% interest.
eligibility_summary: Self-employed artisans aged 18+ in one of the 18 listed trades; one member per family.

steps.title: Register at CSC
steps.detail: With Aadhaar biometric.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: By Gram Panchayat / ULB and district committee.

steps.title: Training and benefits
steps.detail: Attend training, get toolkit and loan.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0
benefit_note: Industry-recognised courses with placement support
summary: Free short-term job training and government certification for young people.
description: PMKVY 4.0 offers free short-term training, recognition of prior learning and courses in new-age skills like AI, drones and electronics, with certification and placement support.
eligibility_summary: Indian youth aged 15–59 who are school/college dropouts, unemployed or looking to upskill.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: On skillindiadigital.gov.in.

steps.title: Choose a course
steps.detail: At a nearby training centre.

steps.title: Get certified
steps.detail: After assessment.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
ministry: Women & Child Development Dept., Uttar Pradesh
benefit_note: Paid in six stages from birth to graduation
summary: Uttar Pradesh pays ₹25,000 in stages to support a daughter from birth through her education.
description: Instalments are paid at birth, full vaccination, admission to Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, and on passing Class 12 and joining graduation or diploma.
eligibility_summary: UP families with annual income up to ₹3 lakh; up to two daughters per family.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.detail: On mksy.up.gov.in.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: By block / district officer.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
benefit_note: Paid directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account
summary: Maharashtra pays ₹1,500 a month to women from low-income families.
description: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or destitute women and one unmarried woman per family, aged 21–65, receive monthly financial support.
eligibility_summary: Maharashtra women aged 21–65 with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

documents.name: Income certificate or yellow/orange ration card

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: On ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in or via Anganwadi / setu kendra.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: By the WCD department.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai
benefit_note: For women heads of family
summary: Tamil Nadu pays ₹1,000 a month to women heads of eligible families.
description: Women heads of families (as per the ration card) aged 21 and above in low-income households receive ₹1,000 a month by direct transfer.
eligibility_summary: Tamil Nadu women heads of family, aged 21+, family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At camps or ration shops during enrolment drives.

steps.title: Check status
steps.detail: On kmut.tn.gov.in.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar
ministry: Women & Child Development Dept., West Bengal
benefit_note: ₹1,200 for SC/ST women
summary: West Bengal gives women aged 25–60 a monthly basic income.
description: Women in families enrolled in Swasthya Sathi receive ₹1,000 a month (₹1,200 for SC/ST women) directly in their bank accounts.
eligibility_summary: West Bengal women aged 25–60 who are not in permanent government jobs.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: At Duare Sarkar camps.

name: Orunodoi 3.0
benefit_note: Paid to the woman of the household
summary: Assam's monthly cash support for women of economically weaker families.
description: Orunodoi transfers ₹1,250 a month to the woman member of eligible low-income households to help with medicines, food and nutrition.
eligibility_summary: Assam households with annual income up to ₹2 lakh; benefit goes to the woman of the family.

steps.title: Apply
steps.detail: Through your Gram Panchayat / ward office during enrolment.

steps.title: Verification
steps.detail: By the district committee.

name: Mukhya Mantri Nijut Moina
benefit_note: Class 11: ₹1,000 · Degree: ₹1,250 · PG: ₹2,500 (10 months a year)
summary: Assam pays unmarried girl students a monthly stipend to keep studying from Class 11 to post-graduation.
description: Girls studying in Class 11, degree and post-graduate courses in government or provincialised institutions in Assam get a monthly stipend for 10 months a year.
eligibility_summary: Unmarried girl students in Assam from Class 11 to PG with family income up to ₹15 lakh.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.detail: On the Nijut Moina portal during the application window.

steps.title: Institute verification
steps.detail: Your college verifies enrolment.
